generation.prompt: Create ONE finished transparent horizontal UK dealership logo proposal with exact text FAIRFIELD on the first line and CAR CENTRE. A bold original F monogram in a minimal arch outline, generous negative space; sophisticated sturdy sans FAIRFIELD with CAR CENTRE below. Isolated compact icon at FAR LEFT occupies about 25 percent width; wordmark to right occupies 65 percent; ample transparent gap separates icon and wordmark so icon can be cropped alone. Flat #233346 ink fills every letter and icon, surrounded by a crisp visible SOLID WHITE KEYLINE around every outside edge and letter counter. White keyline is a permanent part of this dual-contrast logo, making it readable on white, charcoal and red backgrounds. Deep ink with white border only, absolutely no background rectangle or plaque. Clean premium vector-style design, balanced professional spacing, strong legibility, no tagline, no city, no personal name other than the exact trading name. No gradient, texture, grunge, distress, glow, shadows, mockup or vehicles. Transparent alpha with ample empty margins on a 3:1 wide canvas. Only one design, not a sheet of options.
